gen-irish-grover-gf-abeezee: Irish Grover's tall, sturdy lowercase makes every word look big and friendly. ABeeZee is the plainer partner, drawn like neon tubing with no thick-to-thin shift, so the heading's slightly swelling strokes stand out against it.
gen-irish-grover-gf-aldrich: Playful from the first letter, Irish Grover has joins that thin gently without ever turning spindly. And Aldrich, a sans-serif with one stroke width throughout and an x-height near its capitals, brings the crisp, modern side.
gen-irish-grover-gf-alexandria: Alexandria, a plain sans with a tall body and short stems, takes the quiet job here. Irish Grover handles the fun, with gently modulated strokes and no sharp hairlines, while Alexandria keeps its wide c terminals open for the reading.
gen-irish-grover-gf-amiko: Cheerful and a bit homespun, Irish Grover keeps its stems slightly heavier than its hairlines. But Amiko, a sans-serif with crayon-tall lowercase and outward-pointing terminals, is the real strength, since its strokes hardly vary at all.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-bangla: Soft, sturdy and full of character, Irish Grover leans on moderate stroke contrast and tall lowercase letters. Anek Bangla's wide s curves smooth it out.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari is a sans with distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, a modern, even-handed text voice. Anek Devanagari meets Irish Grover's gentle stem-to-joint taper with a uniform line, and that sturdy-against-smooth gap is the pair's best quality.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati is a sans whose lowercase rivals its capitals, with a gaping c opening. And Irish Grover, with arches that thin slightly where they leave the stem, feels homey and hand-shaped beside it.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Irish Grover's tall, sturdy lowercase gives it away at once, with curves that thicken gently at the shoulders. Anek Gurmukhi, a sans-serif, quietly opens up every round letter.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-kannada: Fun and organic, Irish Grover varies its line weight quietly inside each letter, giving headings a warm, hand-shaped feel. Anek Kannada's high x-height and far-reaching terminals keep a longer passage open.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-latin: Irish Grover brings tall, sturdy lowercase and a mid-range gap between its boldest and faintest strokes. Anek Latin, a sans with lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, holds its letters open and keeps the reading plain.
